name: plan-card
title: Plan card
description: One plan as a card: its price and interval, what it includes and the button, with 'Most popular' and 'Your plan' told in words, not only in colour.
docs: Pass the plan's name, a description and the price as { amount, interval, currency, note }. amount is in minor units (2900 is 29.00; a string such as 'Custom' is shown as written), interval is muted after a slash ('/ month') and note is the small line under it ('€288 billed yearly'). A price that changes, as it does when a billing toggle flips, counts to its new value, and a whole price drops its cents. features take plain strings, or { label, included: false } for a feature the plan leaves out, which a screen reader hears as 'Not included'. cta is { label, href?, onClick?, disabled?, loading? }; with an href it renders as a link that needs no JavaScript, and a label too long for the button wraps onto a second line and the button grows with it instead of being cut off. recommended draws a heavier border and the pill 'Most popular' (badge replaces its words, and also works on a card that is not recommended); current replaces the button with 'Your plan' and sets aria-current. locale writes the price, headingAs sets the heading level (h3 by default) and labels holds the fixed words for another language. It keeps no state and renders on the server.
